CodeOfConduct.metaDescription: Kuɔɔth panyda AmplifiedAccess kek löŋ ë kɔc tënë kɔc kony kek kɔc mat.
CodeOfConduct.heroDescription: Adhɛ̈r da tënë panyda cï thiaak, cï lɔ nhom raan kedhiɛ, ku acïn dhiɛɛr tënë raan kedhiɛ.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText1: Ye da mat AmplifiedAccess, kɔc kony, ku bäny, aluɔ̈ɔ̈l löŋ bï mat panyda a ye adhɛ̈r acïn dhiɛɛr tënë raan kedhiɛ, acïn kuc ruɔ̈n, dit ë guɔ̈p, riɔ̈p cï nyuɔ̈th walä cïï, jur, kaŋ mony/tik, rin ku nyuɔ̈th mony/tik, alanh kony, wɛ̈t nyuɔ̈th, alanh piny, panynhial, nyuɔ̈th du, jur, kuɔɔth, mɛ̈th, kek, walä rin mony/tik ku nhiar.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText2: Aluɔ̈ɔ̈l löŋ bï luui ku bï lɔ nhom kek kuɔɔth bï bɛ̈i panyda cï thiaak, cï lɔ nhom raan kedhiɛ, aleu, cï mat, ku pial.
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositiveIntro: Nyuɔ̈th kɔc adhɛ̈r ë bɛ̈i wël pial anɔŋ:
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive1: Nyuɔ̈th piɔ̈l ku pïïr tënë kɔc kɔ̈k
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive2: Lɔ nhom wël, nyin, ku kony aleu
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive3: Bɛ̈i ku lɔ nhom wël kony kek piɔ̈l
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive4: Lɔ nhom adhɛ̈r ku thiëëc dhɛ̈r tënë kɔc cï riɔ̈p kek juër da, ku nyic bei kony
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive5: Lɔ nhom aŋɔ ye pial acïn tënë raanda etok, ee tënë panyda kedhiɛ
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegativeIntro: Nyuɔ̈th kɔc adhɛ̈r cïn nyuɔ̈th anɔŋ:
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative1: Luɔɔi thok walä agany rin/nhiar, ku nyin walä wɛ̈t rin/nhiar ë kuɔɔth kedhiɛ
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative2: Rac tënë kɔc, wël rac walä juër, ku dhiɛɛr raanda walä alanhda
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative4: Tɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ athör du kɔc kɔ̈k, kek gɔl paan walä iimeel, acïn löŋ adëŋ
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative5: Adhɛ̈r kɔ̈k ye leu bï nyic acïn adëŋ kaam luɔɔi
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitiesText1: Bäny panyda AmplifiedAccess anɔŋ luɔɔi bï lɛ̈k ku guiir kuɔɔth adhɛ̈r cï lɔ nhom, ku aa luui adhɛ̈r adëŋ ku aleu tënë adhɛ̈r kedhiɛ ye kek nyic acïn adëŋ, cï dhiɛɛr, rac, walä cï bɛ̈i juër.
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitiesText2: Bäny panyda anɔŋ löŋ ku luɔɔi bï cieec, puk, walä jal wël, commits, koodii, puk wiki, thiëëc, ku kony kɔ̈k acïn adëŋ kek Löŋ Ë Kɔc kï, ku aa lɛ̈k gɔl adhɛ̈r kaam yic.
CodeOfConduct.scopeText: Löŋ Ë Kɔc kï aa luui panyda kedhiɛ, ku aa luui të raan a nyuɔ̈th panyda AmplifiedAccess panyda kedhiɛ. Nyuɔ̈th nyuɔ̈th panyda da anɔŋ luɔɔi iimeel adëŋ, gäär akaawuunt sowal midiya adëŋ, walä bï nyuɔ̈th cï lɔc kaam ë onlain walä cïï.
CodeOfConduct.reportingIntro: Baŋ adhɛ̈r rac, dhiɛɛr, walä acïn nyuɔ̈th kɔ̈k aleu tɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ tënë mat AmplifiedAccess ë:
CodeOfConduct.reportingFollowUp: Baŋ kedhiɛ aa nyin ku guiir akölɛ ku adëŋ. Bäny panyda kedhiɛ anɔŋ luɔɔi bï lɔ nhom kony ku diäär raan cï baŋ athör tɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ.
CodeOfConduct.guidelinesIntro: Bäny panyda aa lɔ nhom alɔŋkä kaam nyic aŋɔ ye juɔ̈r luɔɔi kedhiɛ ye kek nyic acïn adëŋ kek Löŋ Ë Kɔc kï:
CodeOfConduct.correctionImpactText: Luɔɔi thok acïn adëŋ walä adhɛ̈r kɔ̈k nyic acïn kony luɔɔi walä acïn cï lɔ nhom panyda.
CodeOfConduct.correctionConsequenceText: Alɔŋ du gäär bei bäny panyda, bï kony wël kek kuɔɔth juër ku lɛ̈k aŋɔ ye adhɛ̈r acïn adëŋ. Dhɛ̈r panyda aleu ë thiëëc.
CodeOfConduct.warningImpactText: Juër bei baŋ tök walä luɔɔi löny.
CodeOfConduct.warningConsequenceText: Alɔŋ kek juɔ̈r tënë adhɛ̈r cï lɔ nhom. Acïn kony tënë kɔc mat, kek kony acïn thiëëc kek kɔc guiir Löŋ Ë Kɔc, kaam adëŋ. Löŋ kï acïn adëŋ aa bï dhiɛɛr kaam thiin walä kedhiɛ.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanImpactText: Juër diäär kuɔɔth panyda, kek adhɛ̈r acïn kony luɔɔi cï lɔ nhom.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanConsequenceText: Dhiɛɛr kaam thiin tënë kony walä lɛ̈k panyda kaam adëŋ. Kaam kï, acïn kony panyda walä du kek kɔc mat aleu. Löŋ kï acïn adëŋ aa bï dhiɛɛr kedhiɛ.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanImpactText: Nyuɔ̈th kuɔɔth juër kuɔɔth panyda, kek adhɛ̈r acïn kony luɔɔi cï lɔ nhom, dhiɛɛr raan tök, walä rac tënë kuɔɔth kɔc.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanConsequenceText: Dhiɛɛr kedhiɛ tënë kony panyda kuɔɔth kedhiɛ panyda yic.
CodeOfConduct.attributionText: Löŋ Ë Kɔc kï acï bɛ̈i bei <covenantLink>Contributor Covenant</covenantLink>, alanh 2.1, cï yök ë <versionLink>contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct</versionLink>.

Security.metaDescription: Kaam bï yïn baŋ acïn adëŋ ë bɛ̈ny tënë mat AmplifiedAccess.
Security.heroDescription: Kaam da luui baŋ acïn adëŋ ku löŋ da bï nyuɔ̈th kek adhɛ̈r adëŋ.
Security.intro: AmplifiedAccess nyic bɛ̈ny WatchTower apɛi. Aluɔ̈ɔ̈l löŋ luɔɔi kɔc nyic bɛ̈ny ku kɔc panyda kony da bï panyda thiaak tënë raan kedhiɛ.
Security.reportingWarning: Tɔ̈ŋ acïn baŋ acïn adëŋ ë bɛ̈ny lɔɔny thiëëc GitHub panyda.
Security.reportingInstruction: Ye alɔŋ kï, baŋ tënë mat da ë iimeel:
Security.reportingResponseTime: Yïn adhɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ bï yök alɔŋ ë saat 48. Të acïn yök, tɔ̈ŋ puk kek iimeel bï nyuɔ̈th athör du acï yök.
Security.whatToIncludeIntro: Bï kony baŋ du guiir akölɛ, tɔ̈ŋ bɛ̈i wël kï kedhiɛ ye leu:
Security.includeItem1: Kaŋ ë juër (kek SQL injection, cross-site scripting, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, kek kɔ̈k)
Security.includeItem2: Alanh kedhiɛ faayil gɔl bei cï mat kek juër
Security.includeItem3: Gɔl koodii cï rac — dam, commit hash, walä URL adëŋ
Security.includeItem4: Alanh kɔ̈k aduɔ̈ɔ̈r bï puk juër akölɛ
Security.includeItem5: Alɔŋ tïm tënë tïm bï puk juër akölɛ
Security.includeItem6: Nyuɔ̈th adhɛ̈r walä koodii exploit, të aleu
Security.includeItem7: Diäär juër, kek kaam kɔc rac aa leu bï luui kek
Security.disclosurePolicy: AmplifiedAccess aluɔ̈ɔ̈l löŋ <link>Nyuɔ̈th Acïn Adëŋ Cï Mat</link>. Aluɔ̈ɔ̈l thiëëc bï yïn bɛ̈i kaam adëŋ bï nyin ku puk juër cï baŋ acïn nyuɔ̈th panyda.
Security.disclosureFollowUp: Aa lɛ̈k yïn adhɛ̈r da kaam nyin, ku aa bɛ̈i yïn dhɛ̈r të yïn thiëëc.
Security.languageText: Aluɔ̈ɔ̈l thiëëc bï kony bɛ̈ny kedhiɛ a lɔ Thok Ë Ingiliþ.

About.heroDescription: WatchTower ee panyda kony panyda cï luui kek AI ku teknolojii thok panydit bï kɔc baŋ baŋ, lɛ̈th, ku lööŋ raan acïn adëŋ kek thok du, ku puk baŋkä a wël bï luui alɔŋ diäär ku lɛ̈k.
About.objectiveDescription: Nyic raan kedhiɛ anɔŋ löŋ bï baŋ panyda kek thok yen a lueel, bï acïn rol acïn nyic, ku raan kedhiɛ a leu bï mat alɔŋ diäär kɔc anɔŋ luɔɔi.
About.languagesDescription: WatchTower ëmën akony thokdit {count} bï bɛ̈i rol panyda löny bï mat, nyic, ku kony diäär panyda ë thok yen anɔŋ piɔ̈l apɛi.
About.safetyDescription: Aa nyic bï lueel ee bɛ̈i juër. Kï ee kaam WatchTower cï guiir bï yïn kony.
About.faqIdentityQuestion: Nyuɔ̈th da anɔŋ kony të baŋ athör?
About.faqIdentityAnswer: Yïn acïn bɛ̈i rin du, namba mobail, walä athör nyuɔ̈th kek bï baŋ athör. Rin thiaak ee adhɛ̈r a lɔ nhom, acïn adhɛ̈r du.
About.faqAccountAnswer: Acïn piroofaayil bï gäär walä bɛ̈ny lɔ nhom bï nyic. Yïn abï, abaŋ, abï jal. Acïn kï bï mat kek baŋ du.
About.faqEncryptionQuestion: Baŋ da aleu bï puk tënë ɣɛn?
About.faqEncryptionAnswer: Baŋ kedhiɛ aa thiaak bei kaam yïn cï tɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ. Baŋ du acïn kony ë mat walä puk tënë yïn kaam adëŋ.
About.faqVisibilityAnswer: Baŋ athör aa nyin kɔc guiir WatchTower cï adëŋ etok. Baŋ du acïn kony panyda kek athör nyuɔ̈th.
About.faqDeviceQuestion: Aleu bï baŋ bei gäät mat walä panyda?
About.faqDeviceAnswer: Eeŋö. WatchTower acïn athör alanh walä cookies mat kek baŋ du. Baŋ bei gäät mat acïn bï yïn juër.
About.ctaDescription: Tɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ baŋ panyda kek thok du. Akaawuunt acïn aduɔ̈ɔ̈r, athör du acïn aduɔ̈ɔ̈r.

Home.heroDescription: Të panyda aa lueel, wël aa puk. Watchtower akony kɔc bï baŋ panyda ku lööŋ raan kek thok yen aa lueel, bï raan kedhiɛ mat alɔŋ diäär ku diäär panyda.
Home.howItWorksDescription: Bei baŋ tök tënë puk panyda kedhiɛ, kï ee kaam WatchTower akony panyda bï nyic ku bɛ̈i puk adëŋ.
Home.step1Description: Aluɔ̈ɔ̈l teknolojii bï kony kɔc ku panyda bï baŋ panyda walä lööŋ raan bei mobail walä kompiuta kek thok yen aa lueel.
Home.step2Description: Aa nyin ku guiir baŋ kedhiɛ, bï baŋ nyin mapthiin ku bɛ̈i kuɔɔth cï acïn nyic. Athör acïn kony a puk nyic adëŋ ku cï mat bï lɛ̈k athör diäär.
Home.step3Description: Panyda, mat, ku alanh aa luui nyicka bï baŋ juër guiir, kɔc anɔŋ luɔɔi thiëëc, ku bï puk adëŋ bɛ̈i, kek nyuɔ̈th adëŋ bei piny.
Home.speakNaturallyTitle: Speak naturally. WatchTower helps others understand.
Home.speakNaturallyDescription: Report by voice or text in the language you're most comfortable using. WatchTower helps transcribe, translate and structure reports so information can be understood across languages.
Home.insightsHeading: Ideas, stories and insights from the field.
Home.insightsDescription: Explore perspectives on community reporting, civic participation, multilingual technology and how better information can support meaningful action.
Home.insightsFallback1Title: Why local voices matter in understanding what's happening on the ground
Home.insightsFallback2Title: Breaking the language barrier in civic reporting
Home.insightsFallback3Title: From individual reports to meaningful patterns
Home.faqsDescription: Learn more about reporting, languages, privacy and how WatchTower helps make community information useful.
Home.faq1Answer: WatchTower is a multilingual reporting and civic intelligence tool that enables people to report local issues and rights violations in the languages they speak. Reports can then be organised, mapped and analysed to help reveal patterns and support action.
Home.faq2Question: What can I report on WatchTower?
Home.faq2Answer: You can report incidents such as rights violations, safety concerns and other civic issues happening in your community — anything others should know about or that could help inform action.
Home.faq3Question: Can I report in my own language?
Home.faq3Answer: Yes. You can report by voice or text in the language you're most comfortable using, and WatchTower helps transcribe, translate and structure your report so it can be understood across languages.
Home.faq4Question: Can I submit a report anonymously?
Home.faq4Answer: Yes. Anonymous is the default, not the exception — you never need to provide your name or any identifying information to file a report.
Home.faq5Question: What happens after I submit a report?
Home.faq5Answer: Every report is processed and verified, mapped alongside others to surface patterns, and shared with communities, organizations and institutions who can act on it.
Home.impactDescription: Nyic kaam panyda aa nyic, guiir juër, ku bɛ̈i luɔɔi.
Home.ctaDescription: Guiir baŋ panyda kek Watchtower, walä nyin wël kaam adëŋ ë mapthiin da.
Home.missionStatement: Watchtower akony panyda bï baŋ kaam kɔc lueel, bï nyic kuɔɔth alɔŋ baŋ, ku bï puk athör bei piny ta bï nyic yenë kony luɔɔi.
Home.exploreDescription: Nyin baŋ alɔŋ bay, jɔl, thok, ku kaam bï nyic kaam bei piny.
